verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Monitors, which are condition-based rules over telemetry, and lists Incident Management, so rule-driven triggering on events is clearly part of the platform. However, the items are page titles only, with no detail on which automated actions a rule can fire or how they are configured. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable automated actions beyond alerting (e.g. workflow automation or remediation), detail on event-trigger rule definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
